marginal_rule: Every number in this module is a MARGINAL measurement: two arms built from one state, differing only by the item, with every other effect active in both.  Anything the player already prices therefore measures as zero here, by construction.

extra.note: gross is the item's realized payout (probe); d_money is the CRN with-vs-without final-money delta and is SMALLER because the money gets spent and the arms diverge.
